ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
(Heilongjiang Province Daqing Experimental High School 2016 senior high school pre-exam score-gaining training (4) science comprehensive physics test question) As shown in the figure, metal spherical shell A carries positive charge, and there is a small hole a above it. The metal ball b of electroscope B is connected by a wire to small metal ball c. The phenomena that occur in the following operations are correct: (     )
A. Move c close to A, but do not make contact with A; B will open by a certain angle
B. After making c contact the outer surface of A, move it away from A; B will not open by a certain angle
C. When making c contact the inner surface of A, B will not open by an angle
D. Detach c from the wire, then suspend it with an insulating thin string, place it into A through the small hole in A, make it contact its inner wall, then take it out of the cavity and make it contact b; B will open by a certain angle

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a positively charged metal hollow spherical shell A, with positive signs marked near the outer surface, and a small hole a above; on the right side is electroscope B, whose metal ball b is connected to small metal ball c through a wire, and the opening of the electroscope indicates that b and the conductor system connected to it are charged. Reasoning: For a charged metal cavity conductor in electrostatic equilibrium and with no charged body inside the cavity, net charge is distributed only on the outer surface, and there is no net charge on the inner surface. In option A, although c does not contact A, when it is close to positively charged A, electrostatic induction occurs in the c-b system connected to the electroscope, part of the electroscope carries the same kind of charge, B will open, so A is correct. In option B, after c contacts the outer surface of A, the c-b-electroscope system will obtain charge from positively charged A, and after being moved away it is still charged, B will open, so “will not open” is wrong. In option C, when c is still connected to B and contacts the inner surface of A, A, c, b, and the electroscope become the same conductor, and charge can be redistributed to the external electroscope, B will open, so “will not open” is wrong. In option D, if c is first detached from the wire, c as an isolated neutral small ball is put into the cavity and contacts the inner wall; since the inner surface has no net charge, after c is taken out it is still uncharged, and then contacting b cannot make B open, so D is wrong. Therefore the correct option is A.

method.method_draft: 按四个操作逐项判定静电计是否带电。先从图中确认：A是带正电的金属空心球壳，上方有小孔a；静电计B的金属球b通过导线与小金属球c相连，B张开表示b及静电计系统带电。再读题干和选项，区分“不接触靠近”“接触外表面”“接触内表面”“c先断开后在空腔内接触再取出”。运用导体静电平衡规律：带电空腔导体若腔内无带电体，电荷分布在外表面，内表面无净电荷；靠近带电体会使与静电计相连的导体发生感应带电；接触带电导体外表面会使静电计系统得电；若c仍接在B上并接触A内壁，B-A-c成为同一导体，电荷可重新分布到外部的B上，故B会张开；若c先与B断开、作为孤立中性小球在空腔内接触内壁，由于内表面无电荷，取出后仍不带电，再碰b不会使B张开。由此A正确，B、C、D错误。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是带正电的金属空心球壳A，外表面附近标有正号，上方有小孔a；右侧是静电计B，其金属球b通过导线与小金属球c相连，静电计张开表示b及与其相连的导体系统带电。推理：带电金属空腔导体在静电平衡且腔内无带电体时，净电荷只分布在外表面，内表面无净电荷。A项，c虽不接触A，但靠近带正电的A时，与静电计相连的c-b系统发生静电感应，静电计部分带同种电，B会张开，A正确。B项，c与A外表面接触后，c-b-静电计系统会从带正电的A得到电荷，移开后仍带电，B会张开，所以“不会张开”错误。C项，c仍与B相连并接触A内表面时，A、c、b及静电计成为同一导体，电荷可重新分布到外部的静电计上，B会张开，所以“不会张开”错误。D项，若先把c从导线上解下，c作为孤立中性小球放入空腔并接触内壁，由于内表面无净电荷，c取出后仍不带电，再与b接触不能使B张开，故D错误。因此正确选项为A。

raw_record.original_question:
如图所示，金属球壳A带有正电，其上方有一小孔a，静电计B的金属球b用导线与金属小球c相连。以下操作所发生的现象正确的是（ ）
A. 将c移近A，但不与A接触，B会张开一定角度
B. 将c与A外表面接触后移开A，B不会张开一定角度
C. 将c与A内表面接触时，B不会张开角度
D. 将c从导线上解下，然后用绝缘细绳吊着从A中小孔置入A内，并与其内壁接触，再提出空腔，与b接触，B会张开一定角度
